purpose: Teach: 覆い/明かさ/少数/気がつい/人民/調和/振れ/成人

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、世間に覆い隠された事実を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Sakura, your paper dealt with facts that society tends to keep hidden, didn't it?
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. Gentle confirmation rather than interrogation. Opens with her name to signal genuine engagement. Steady pace, calm authority.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、口を明かさなかった証人を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on testimonies from people who had stayed silent about what they'd witnessed.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Slight breath before the dash to signal collecting her thoughts. Clear articulation — she's proud of this work but not defensive about it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 少数派の意見を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And you explored minority perspectives throughout your research, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, inviting tone. Not leading — genuinely curious about her methodology. Slower pace on the second half, drawing out the question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、調査時に気がついた偏りを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — while I was conducting my survey, I noticed certain biases in how data was being interpreted, so I made that a central focus.
lines.style: Articulate and self-assured. She's explaining her own critical thinking, not just reciting. Slight emphasis on 'I noticed' — she caught something others might have missed. Measured, not rushed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人民の自治を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Your paper also examined how communities can maintain agency and self-determination, didn't it?
lines.style: Engaged and attentive. The question is warm but precise — she's tracking his thinking carefully. Slight lift at the end, inviting elaboration without pressure.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、伝統と現代の調和を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at how tradition and modern practices could exist together without one erasing the other.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reflective. She's articulating something she cares about. Slight pause before answering, choosing words carefully. Sincere, not performative.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 世論の振れ幅を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: So you examined how public opinion shifts and changes over time?
lines.style: Gently probing. She's tying threads together, inviting him to see the larger pattern. Warm and measured. No rush in her delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、成人式の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I traced how coming-of-age ceremonies have transformed across history, reflecting broader changes in what society values.
lines.style: Clear and composed closing statement. She brings it home with specificity and insight. Breath of completion at the end — the thought is finished, she's secure in what she's said. Genuine pride beneath the calm.
